name: Inquest
overview: The Scriptures in Deuteronomy 21:1-6 outline a solemn procedure for an inquest when a slain person is found with no known murderer. The elders and judges of the nearest city are tasked with investigating by measuring the surrounding cities and performing a symbolic ritual involving a heifer, which is unworked and unyoked, in a rough valley. The priests, chosen by the LORD to minister and bless, provide authoritative judgment to resolve the controversy. This process underscores God’s provision for justice and purity in the community through divinely appointed leaders and prescribed rites.
